findings.title: deleteMany with retryCount condition lacks method filter, will delete non-SMS reminders
findings.body: The second condition in the OR clause `{ retryCount: { gt: 1 } }` has no `method` filter. This means any WorkflowReminder row (including EMAIL and WHATSAPP methods) with a retryCount greater than 1 will be deleted by this query. While currently only SMS reminders have their retryCount incremented in this file, the query is semantically incorrect and poses a data integrity risk if any other code path ever increments retryCount for non-SMS reminders. The condition should include `method: WorkflowMethods.SMS` to match the intent described in the PR.

findings.title: retryCount deletion condition does not filter by scheduled status, may delete successfully scheduled reminders
findings.body: The `retryCount: { gt: 1 }` condition in the deleteMany does not include `scheduled: false`. If a reminder was successfully scheduled (scheduled=true, referenceId set) but somehow its retryCount was incremented in a prior failed attempt before eventually succeeding, it would be deleted by this condition, potentially orphaning a valid Twilio scheduled message. Adding `scheduled: false` to the condition would make the intent clearer and safer.
